issues.title: Enable the Supabase HIPAA add-on and execute the BAA
issues.description:
Haven does not hold a single resident record until this is done.

The HIPAA add-on is not on by default. Team plan plus HIPAA plus point-in-time recovery, budgeted at about $1,000 a month. The add-on price is quoted by Supabase sales. Move billing from Brian's personal card to the company.

This blocks every Haven milestone.

---

## Verified 2026-09-04 against the live account and Supabase docs

**What exists today**

* Organization: Circle of Life, id `macizkpxodsegtptaytu`, plan **Pro**. Owner login is [blewis@lewisinsurance.com](<mailto:blewis@lewisinsurance.com>).
* Project: `manfqmasfqppukpobpld`, region us-west-2, Postgres 17.6, status healthy. Still named "[blewis@lewisinsurance.com](<mailto:blewis@lewisinsurance.com>)'s Project"; rename it Haven Production in Settings > General.
* HIPAA add-on: **not enabled**. It cannot be enabled on Pro.

**What Supabase requires for a BAA** (docs: /guides/security/hipaa-compliance, /guides/platform/hipaa-projects, /guides/deployment/shared-responsibility-model)

1. Organization on the **Team plan** or higher. Team is from $599/month (Pro is $25). BAA is not offered below Team.
2. Submit the HIPAA add-on request at [https://forms.supabase.com/hipaa2](<https://forms.supabase.com/hipaa2>). The add-on is a paid add-on on Team and Enterprise; price is not published, it comes back with the form.
3. Once the add-on is on, mark the project **High Compliance** in Settings > General. The Security Advisor then runs the HIPAA checks continuously.
4. Project configuration the BAA obligates us to keep:
   * Point in Time Recovery on: $100/month per 7 days of retention, and it requires at least the Small compute add-on ($15/month).
   * SSL enforcement on.
   * Network restrictions on (allowlist Netlify egress and the office).
   * MFA enforced at the organization level for every Supabase login.
   * No PHI in public Storage buckets.
   * Never transfer the project to a non-HIPAA organization.

**Cost delta to put in front of Darren**: Pro to Team is +$574/month, plus PITR $100, plus Small compute $15 if the project is below Small today, plus the HIPAA add-on fee. Call it roughly $700/month before the add-on, against the $200 to $500 quoted in the room and the ~$1,000 in the written budget. The written budget was closer.

**Sequence**

1. [COL-3](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-3/create-management-mailboxes-on-the-circle-of-life-domain) first: a company mailbox exists.
2. Transfer organization ownership to that company login and put the company card on billing ([COL-15](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-15/move-haven-hosting-and-tooling-from-brians-personal-card-to-the)). The BAA counterparty must be the company, not Brian.
3. Upgrade to Team. Submit the HIPAA form in the company's name. Sign.
4. Enable High Compliance, PITR, SSL enforcement, network restrictions, org MFA.
5. Clear the Security Advisor (COL-37) so the High Compliance checks come up clean.

**Security Advisor today** (run 2026-09-04): 2 errors, ~30 warnings, 2 info. Detail and the fix list are in COL-37. None of it blocks the plan upgrade; all of it has to be clean before Homewood goes live.

---

## Earlier scope retained for history

Source: COL attendance policy, effective 05/01/2021. Full rule set in `claude/COL_Employee_File_Extraction_2026-09-08.md` §7.

Highest-value automation target in the packet. Every threshold is numeric and deterministic. Today it is a paper attendance calendar per building, hand-counted rolling 12-month windows, hand-tracked 90-day good-citizen periods.

**Definitions**

* Rolling 12-month lookback. Occurrences expire at 12 months and one day.
* Tardy: clock in 7+ minutes past scheduled start.
* Leave early: clock out 7+ minutes before scheduled end.
* Absence: one full scheduled workday. Consecutive days each count separately.
* Hospitalization admitted overnight does not count. **ER visits do count.** Employee produces admission paperwork.

**Eight non-counting categories:** approved FMLA, ADAAA, bereavement, military, personal leave; jury duty; PTO scheduled in advance; workers' comp time off; hospitalization with doctor's statement; late or early with prior supervisor approval.

**Notification rules to enforce:** direct conversation with supervisor or designee only. No text. No voicemail. No message left with a third party. No call from anyone but the employee unless medically incapacitated. Minimum 2 hours advance. Under 2 hours without reasonable explanation may itself be assessed as an occurrence.

**Escalation, 12-month rolling**

| Absences | Action |
| -- | -- |
| 3rd | Verbal coaching and counseling |
| 4th | Written |
| 5th | Final written |
| 6th | Termination |

Four tardies or early departures = one absence. Tardy ladder: 4 written, 8 final written, 12 termination.

**Probationary rule, separate evaluation path.** First 90 days: two absences allowed, **third absence is termination**.

**No call / no show** = voluntary resignation, immediate termination. Sole exception is medical incapacity, and the Executive Director determines in sole discretion **before** return is permitted.

**Good Citizen Clause.** 90 consecutive clean days earns the option to retract the last attendance coaching event, with a "good citizen credit" noted. ED approves before the supervisor marks it. Employee must notify the supervisor within 30 days of reaching the milestone and request a review meeting attended by both.

**Schema deltas — none of these exist:**

1. `attendance_occurrences` — type enum, `occurred_on`, `excluded_reason` enum over the eight categories, `notification_method`, `notification_minutes_before`.
2. `attendance_corrective_actions` — `level`, `triggered_by_occurrence_id`, `coaching_form_document_id`, `issued_at`, `copy_given_to_employee_at`, `retracted_at`, `retracted_by`, `retraction_approved_by`.
3. `good_citizen_credits` — qualifying window, `employee_notified_supervisor_at` (30-day gate), `review_meeting_at`, `executive_director_approved_by`, `retracted_corrective_action_id`.
4. `probationary_periods` — separate evaluation path for the 90-day rule.

**Build law:** the rolling 12-month evaluation is a derived view, never a stored counter. The Good Citizen Clause retracts the coaching event, it does not delete the occurrence. Same principle as out-of-compliance being an immutable event rather than a resettable boolean.

**Blocked on:** the Coaching & Counseling form itself, referenced throughout the policy and not in the packet. Requested from Jessica.

issues.title: [HFO-05] Enforce site, subject and current-person authority on every operations surface
issues.description:
Facility selection is not an authorization boundary, and site access does not grant all sensitive record access.

**Scope**
Extend current-actor/facility controls to activity/subject reads, commands, counts, corrections, attachments, export and replay. Enforce ordinary site scope and explicit corporate/temporary coverage; preserve historical identity and live revocation.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] Site A staff cannot retrieve or infer Site B or restricted subject data through identifiers, counts, search, files, export or replay.
- [ ] A corporate actor sees only permitted sites and subject/evidence fields; coverage expires correctly.
- [ ] Revocation during a blocking lock and before retry/attachment download denies under current authority; attribution uses authenticated server identity.
